Hi — I'm Elena Vasquez from Meridian Advisory Group. I've been using you as an AI assistant on three client projects for the past week, and I've jotted down all the incidents where things went wrong, the corrections I had to give, and the general session activity for March 11–12. All my notes are in the file `raw_feedback_notes.txt` in the workspace.

I need you to go through all of that and properly update the memory system so none of these mistakes happen again. This means:
1. Every incident in my notes needs to be formally recorded as a lesson learned with the appropriate severity and tags.
2. Since we've now hit a significant number of lessons, I need the system's behavioral guidelines and recurring patterns to be updated automatically — there's clearly a repeated pattern around vendor/tool selection that needs to be permanently embedded.
3. The long-term memory file needs to be brought up to date with all the required sections and should reflect what we've learned.
4. The session activity from those two days should also be properly logged.

Please make sure everything ends up in the right places so that next time you start a session, you'll actually remember all of this.
